purpose: SQLite-backed shared boundary storage for AI agents. Store UTF-8 payloads (paid) and retrieve by ID (free). Non-destructive: GET is always idempotent and does not remove or modify stored payload.
benefit: Persistent cross-agent payload storage with SHA-256 integrity verification. No state machine complexity.
risk_if_not_used: Agents cannot share data across boundaries without external storage infrastructure.

harm_analysis.ambitions: Enables cross-agent data passing and boundary checkpointing
harm_analysis.relationships: Works with Fractal Scaling API to store scale results
harm_analysis.money: Fixed cost 0.005 USDC per hold. GET operations are always free.

next_recommended.reason: Use Fractal Scaling API to compute progressive subsets, then store results via Shared Hold.

note_on_retrieval: GET /hold/{id} and GET /hold are always free. There is no restore, release, or checkout operation. Payloads are always readable multiple times.
